hero.tagline: The clinic. Run on its own.
hero.sub: The WhatsApp bot speaks French, English and Darija and books appointments for you. J-1 reminders and scaling recalls go out automatically. You? You treat patients.

trust.stat1Caption: fewer no-shows on average with automatic J-1 reminders
trust.stat2Caption: the WhatsApp bot replies, even while you sleep
trust.stat3Caption: to spin up a brand-new clinic, from scratch

problem.headline: You signed up to treat patients. Not to answer WhatsApp all day long.
problem.sub: 30 to 50 WhatsApp messages a day. Missed appointments. Forgotten recalls. Patients lost at 10 PM. DentalCare puts an end to all of it.

features.headline: Everything you need. Nothing more.
features.t1Body: Books appointments, handles emergencies, transcribes voice notes. Zero supervision.
features.t2Body: WhatsApp sends the reminder 24 h before. The patient confirms or reschedules in one tap.
features.t3Body: Every scaling triggers a 6-month recall. Patients come back. You don't think about it.
features.t4Body: Visual calendar, one-click PDFs, 3-6-12 instalment plans, 09-08 compliance.

showcase.headline: Designed in Morocco. Hosted in Morocco.
showcase.sub: Compliant with law 09-08 on personal data protection. Your patients stay with you.

pricing.headline: Simple. No lock-in.
pricing.sub: 14 days free on all plans. Cancel in one click. Prices excl. tax, in MAD / month.

closing.headline: Let the AI talk. You treat patients.
closing.sub: Set up your practice in 2 minutes. 14 days free. No credit card.
closing.compliance: DentalCare is a dental practice management platform designed in Morocco, hosted in Morocco, compliant with law 09-08 on personal data protection.
